remarks: Dynamic Multi-Level Contemporary boasts flexible design, large open spaces, sliders to a variety of handsome outdoor venues for easy indoor-outdoor living ... PLUS a "Magazine Worthy" custom designed Gourmet Chef's EIK. The home features vaulted ceilings, stunning use of glass, stone and wood, sun room and 2-distinct decks. Great room w/majestic stone fpl, beamed vltd ceiling & wet bar has slider to dramatic skylit, multi room 3-season solarium/sun rm that opens to balcony/deck - a grand layout for entertaining year 'round. Formal dining room w/interesting architectural detail & French door to 2nd deck, has double case opening to your dream kitchen w/island, granite countertops, abundant cabinetry, stainless applcs, wide board hdwd flr, even a built-in banquette dining area and delightful custom office. Family room w/stone wall fpl, bathroom and walk in closet, is on the entry level, where it provides exceptional options for your family's needs. It can be the perfect in-law, nanny, guest or office suite or ideal as a play / family room. The bedroom level boasts Primary suite w/wood stove, double sink bathroom & WI closet. 3-add'l BRs each have vltd ceilings and hdwd floors, while the stylish hall bathroom has been nicely renovated. Cozy office completes this level. Pretty property has level usable areas & woodlands privacy + 2-storage sheds. Innovative Geothermal heating keeps costs down and comfort up-feature sheet tells all! Unique country contemporary fits all your needs!
